name: Linked issue
about: Use this template when creating an issue that PRs should reference
title: '[<component>] Short summary'
labels: ['needs-triage']

---

## Summary
A short, one-line summary of the problem or feature.

## Context
Why this issue matters and which project/component it affects.

## Acceptance criteria
- Clear, testable criteria for completion

## Steps / Reproduction
(If a bug) Steps to reproduce.

## Related
Mention related notes, PRs or docs. Use `Closes #<issue-number>` when resolving.
